summary_for_principal:
You asked me to work through the checklist a past session flagged but never confirmed. This PR closes two of eight items.

First: three documentation spots described the engine wrong — one said it only supports one way of writing data (it actually supports four, added weeks ago but never written up), and two others said it runs on a third-party library it was never built on. No behavior change, just accuracy.

Second, more substantial: the specification's own worked example had a broken rule — 'ask a person to sign off only when confidence is insufficient' — but the process always stops earlier, honestly, whenever confidence actually is insufficient, so that rule could never fire. Because a test fixture copied the example verbatim, one of three approval paths was never actually tested. Fixed the condition so it's reachable, and added a test proving it now works.

Full test suite: 345 passed, plus 1 new. Nothing changes for anyone using the engine today — this closes a testing gap and a documentation gap.

Numbered actions:
1. Nothing needs deciding right now.
2. Six more checklist items remain — continuing through them next unless you'd rather reprioritize.
